pending: Midplane tributaries assign vertical force and the ring rows share the pile-head moment equally; all rings are assumed to engage. Concrete transfer (including concrete below rings), splitting/breakout and row compatibility need a separately substantiated load path.

Ring moments follow pile-head rotational stiffness against the rigid-wall rotation (D-070). The free length to fixity and the axial spring length are entered values (defaults from the pier pile case with sand depth to fixity, LRFD 10.7.3.13.4; tip elevation pending). Lateral, thermal, unsymmetric and construction-stage rotations enter only through the imposed rotation input.
Wall checks cover minimum shrinkage/temperature steel and detailing only. Wall flexure, shear, lateral loads, seismic and strength load paths are outside this calculation.
Local plate and double-fillet checks do not establish pipe-shell bending/ovalization, global pile interaction, ring-segment splices, fatigue, corrosion or WPS/fabrication adequacy.
Confirm geometry, exposure/cover, material grades, construction joints and bar anchorage routing. Starting dimensions are the earlier study snapshot, not a current CAD import.
